meta.description: Track debts, pick a payoff strategy, and see a live debt-free date.

nav.tagline: Small steps, big freedom. You're doing great.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to pick up your payoff plan.
auth.signupSubtitle: Create an account. Language and currency are separate choices.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm the account, then log in.
auth.currencyHint: Suggested from your browser language. You can change it. Amounts are stored as numbers and are not converted.
auth.languageHint: Changes the interface only. It does not change your currency.

demo.title: Look around without an account
demo.body: A temporary workspace opens with sample debts. You can add and change them. It resets within a day.
demo.homeBody: Try the demo with sample debts, or log in if this is already your account.
demo.banner: This is a temporary demo. Changes reset within a day.
demo.keep: Create an account to keep this
demo.keepHint: Your debts stay on this account. It will not be deleted overnight.
demo.kept: Check your email to confirm. After that, this demo becomes your account.

limits.demo_full: The demo is full right now. Try again tomorrow, or create an account.
limits.row_limit_exceeded: This workspace has reached its row limit.
limits.name_invalid: Debt names must be 1 to 80 characters.
limits.category_invalid: Choose a category from the list.

dashboard.monthsFromNow: {count, plural, one {# month from now — you've got this.} other {# months from now — you've got this.}}
dashboard.addMore: Add debts to see a projected date.
dashboard.projectedHint: Debt balance declining toward zero over time
dashboard.emptyBody: Add your first debt and we'll build a personalised payoff plan — no judgment, just a clear path forward.
dashboard.emptyCta: Head to Debts to get started

debts.title: My Debts
debts.count: {count, plural, one {# debt} other {# debts}} · {amount} remaining
debts.emptyBody: Facing your debt is the first step to freedom. Add your debts and we'll help you knock them out, one at a time.
debts.name: Name
debts.sampleHint: Example figures are stored as-is in your currency. They are not converted.

debtForm.addSubtitle: Every debt you track is a debt you can conquer.
debtForm.name: Debt name

payment.title: Log a payment
payment.subtitle: This reduces the current balance. The original balance stays the same.

budget.title: Monthly budget
budget.subtitle: Understanding your cashflow helps you free up more for debt payoff.
budget.leftoverGood: {percent}% of your income — a solid position to accelerate payoff.
budget.leftoverBad: You're spending more than you earn. Consider reducing some categories.
budget.leftoverNote: Applying this as extra each month shortens the path to freedom.

plan.title: Payoff plan
plan.subtitle: See how extra payments change your path to freedom.
plan.extraHint: Simulate paying more than the minimum each month
plan.gap: The shaded gap shows {months} months you'll save by paying {amount} extra each month.
plan.gapEmpty: Add an extra monthly payment above to see how much sooner you'll be debt-free.
plan.milestonesEmpty: Milestones will appear as your payoff plan generates.
plan.emptyBody: Once you add your debts, we'll build a personalised payoff timeline — with milestones to celebrate along the way.

milestone.halfwayDescription: You've paid off half your total debt
milestone.debtPaidDescription: You've fully paid off this debt

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language changes the interface. Currency is your balance unit. They are not linked.
settings.languageHint: Changing language does not change any amounts.
settings.currencyHint: Changing currency does not convert amounts. Confirm before you save.

currencyChange.title: Change currency without converting?
currencyChange.body: Amounts stay the same numbers. They will be read as {currency} instead. That changes the real value of every debt, income, expense, and payment. This app does not use exchange rates.
currencyChange.confirm: I understand the stored amounts will not be converted and the real value will change.

setup.title: Connect Supabase
setup.body: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to frontend/.env.local, then apply backend/supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql and 0002_demo_limits.sql.
